name: Nimrod
bio:
Nimrod is the son of Cush and grandson of Ham. Scripture calls him "a mighty one in the earth" and "a mighty hunter before the LORD," so renowned that "even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD" became a common saying describing a man of great might (Genesis 10:8-9).

His kingdom began with Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh in the land of Shinar, and later extended into Assyria, where he built great cities including Nineveh (Genesis 10:10-12). Nimrod is the earliest figure in Scripture described as building a "kingdom" and a center of power, and many traditions connect him with the building of the Tower of Babel in Shinar (Genesis 11), viewing him as representative of early humanity's drive toward centralized power and rebellion against God in an attempt to "make a name" for itself.
